visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, brownish hair and a white tank top sits in front of a glass cabinet filled with designer handbags. She smiles brightly and runs her hands through her hair, emphasizing its texture. The room is well-lit with soft, warm indoor lighting that highlights her clear skin and the jewelry on her wrists. (2) The camera zooms in to show a close-up of the woman's scalp as she parts her hair with her fingers. She holds a blue and green spray bottle of KARUI scalp essence and applies it directly to the roots. The bottle has a distinct white nozzle, and the setting remains the same well-organized indoor room. (3) The scene shifts to a bathroom where she holds up large bottles of KARUI shampoo and scalp liquid. She demonstrates the products' consistency and applies them to her hair, creating a rich white lather. The background features a white bathtub and tiled walls, with bright, clean indoor lighting illuminating the products. (4) In a different outfit, a white knit sweater, she uses a wooden hairbrush with a large rectangular head to massage her scalp. She continues to speak to the camera with expressive facial expressions and hand gestures. The background shows a dimly lit room with hints of a closet and more handbags.

The audio is extremely clean with a studio-quality noise floor and no ambient distractions. (2) A sharp, percussive "spray" sound effect occurs twice as the woman applies the essence, marking a new phase. The speaker's voice remains energetic with a high arousal level and clear articulation. The background music continues at a steady volume, providing a consistent rhythmic foundation for the narration. (3) A short "whoosh" transition sound effect triggers the start of this phase. The female speaker continues to explain the hair care routine in a friendly and professional manner. The BGM remains present with a major-key tonality and soft synthesizer pads adding depth to the mix. (4) The sound of a "click" from a bottle cap and a soft "splash" of liquid are heard as she handles different products. The vocal delivery is fast-paced with many rising intonations, conveying excitement. The music stays consistently balanced under the speech, with no clipping or technical distortion. (5) A distinct "ding" sound effect coincides with a visual text overlay, starting the final phase. The narrator delivers a concluding call to action with high confidence and a positive valence. The acoustic guitar in the BGM becomes more prominent before the track reaches its final cadence.
